Daily Devotional

June 16

9 Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name: 10 That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth; 11 And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father. (Philippians 2:9-11 KJV)

Because Jesus obeyed God the Father, and came to earth to die for us, He now has His name above everything that has a name, as He is given all power in Heaven and earth (Matthew 28:18). That means every thing, including sickness, disease, poverty, and anything else that can be named. The power of the name of Jesus is greater then anything else in Heaven, on earth, or below the earth, so His name is greater than anything. Wow, and to think that we are in the body of Christ that bears that wonderful name, and have access to the use and power that the name of Jesus provides (John 14:13-14).

Notice that everything that has a tongue will confess that Jesus is Lord when He comes again. All those that do not believe in Jesus in this life will still have to confess that He is Lord when He comes in judgment of this world. Why anyone would wait to confess Jesus is Lord until then, just doesn’t make sense, as it will then be to late to be saved, and after having to make that confession, they will be thrown into the lake of fire to suffer for eternity (Revelation 20:15). Thank you Father that you have given us the chance to confess Jesus in this life, so we can not only spend eternity with you (Revelation 21:3), but we can now enjoy fellowship with you and Jesus (John 17:3), as well as all the other benefits, in this life. Thank you Jesus for what you have done for us who believe in you!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
